Knowledge Artifact Metadata
Name (machine-readable) TrustDemoIND04
Title (human-readable) TD.IND.04 Imported doses carrying a national schedule code
Status Draft
Experimental true
Description

Of the foreign doses imported as verified, the proportion that carry a national schedule code beside the issuer's code, and so count toward the schedule.
Measure Steward litlfred
Steward Contact Details litlfred: https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo
Measure Metadata
Version Number 0.1.0
Measure Scoring Proportion
Guidance

A definition only: it states no target and no value. Data elements: TD.J3B.DE01 Issuer's product code; TD.J3B.DE02 National schedule code; TD.J3B.DE03 Mapping basis; TD.J3B.DE05 Counts toward the schedule. Decision tables: TD.DT.02, TD.DT.03. Requirements: STD-SEM-001, STD-SCH-001. The populations are described, not computable: this guide carries no CQL.
Measure Population Criteria
Denominator Description:

Doses imported as verified in the reporting period.
Numerator Description:

Doses imported as verified in the reporting period that carry a national schedule code.
Stratifier Code: Mapping basis
Description: concept-map, clinician-confirmed, unmapped (TD.DT.02)
Stratifier Code: Issuer's product code
Description: the product as signed
